Item.Description: A transparency slide showing the right side of a carousel pig’s neck. The skin of the pig is light tan but darkens in near the saddle. The saddle is brown. The saddle blanket is green with some yellow details. The tack is red with a brown clasp detail. The pig is very worn, there are many places that have the paint worn off. The ears of the pig appear to be a different color brown, suggesting that the ears have been replaced. The pig is suspended on a pole, which can be seen coming up through the pig right in front of the saddle. The slide reads “PULLEN PARK CAROUSEL PULLEN PARK 16B right neck” at the top and “RALEIGH NC WAKE CO S.S. 8.5.81 JUL81D9” at the bottom.

Title: Pullen Park Carousel - PPC2019.001.533
